## THE ESSENTIAL RESOURCE FOR ThE COPPER MARkET In the last 12 months, the global copper market has rebounded more quickly than anybody expected. We have a market fuelled by real consumption, disciplined production growth, a challenging smelting & refining environment and large investor appetite. The questions being asked now are: Is this the return of the supercycle? Who is best positioned to benefit? #### **ContentS** ###### **exeCutive Summary** ###### **Chapter 1** LONG-TERM TRENDS IN CONSUMPTION - Introduction - Determining long-term rates of demand growth By reviewing and fully-updating our bottom-up, sector-led, demand predictions through to 2035, we aim to prove that the current growth re-emergence is both Asia-centric and fully sustainable. Our comprehensive copper mine project profiles pack, containing the most influential projects in existence today, will show that sufficient copper reserves do exist to meet this long-term demand opportunity. However, at what price? Our cost analysis will fully utilise CRU’s expertise from our teams based in London, Beijing, Santiago and Perth. Their research suggests that current metal prices are more indicative of the future than of the past. We will also review the ownership structure of the mine projects and the implications this has for the delivery pipeline and opportunities for junior mining development. Finally we offer our view on the qualities we think will be prevalent in successful mines, smelters and refineries looking to benefit from current developments in the copper story. - Regional forecasts - Structural changes in intensity of use ###### **Chapter 2** NEW INVESTMENT IN MINE SUPPLY - Production from existing operations - Greenfield projects - New technology ###### **Chapter 3** LONG-TERM PRICE OUTLOOK AND RISK - Historical price analysis - The prospects for prices in the long-run - LRmC sensitivities ###### **appendiCeS** - Copper compass methodology ###### **a SuBSCription provideS:** - MARCH 2010 - FULL REPORT - mARCH 2010 - COLLECTION OF COPPER mINE PROJECT PROFILES - MARCH 2010 - CONFERENCE CALL WITH EDITOR - AUGUST 2010 - UPDATED COLLECTION OF COPPER mINE PROJECT PROFILES - List of copper projects and prospects - New technology - Long-run global macroeconomic outlook ###### **aLSo provided SeparateLy** ###### COLLECTION OF COPPER MINE PROJECT PROFILES - Published in march 2010 with the full study - Fully-updated in August 2010 - ACCESS TO CRU’S COPPER ANALYSTS IN LONDON, BEIJING AND SANTIAGO - ACCESS TO THE STUDY ONLINE AND IN HARD COPY - COmPREHENSIVE APPENDICES OF SUPPORTING DATA IN EXCEL pROJ
